app_tagline: [डोगरी] Speak your problem. We find your scheme.
consent_body: [डोगरी] We collect only minimum details to match you with government schemes. Voice recordings are kept securely for 30 days and then automatically deleted. You can delete your data at any time from Settings.
mode_selection_title: [डोगरी] How would you like to use Umeed?
mode_text_badge: [डोगरी] For those who can read and type
mode_text_subtitle: [डोगरी] Type your details in a familiar form.
mode_audio_prompt: [डोगरी] Press the orange button to speak, or the blue button to type.
q_gender: [डोगरी] Are you a woman, a man, or other?
q_state: [डोगरी] Which state do you live in?
q_area: [डोगरी] Do you live in a village or a city?
q_caste: [डोगरी] Which category do you belong to? (General, OBC, SC, ST). You may skip this.
q_income: [डोगरी] About how much does your family earn in a year?
q_occupation: [डोगरी] What work do you do? (Farmer, student, laborer, homemaker, business, other)
q_disability: [डोगरी] Do you have any disability? You may skip this.
q_family: [डोगरी] How many people live in your family?
q_need: [डोगरी] What kind of help do you need most? (Farming, education, health, housing, money, jobs)
caste_why: [डोगरी] Certain government schemes provide special grants, subsidies, or reservations specifically for SC, ST, or OBC categories.
income_why: [डोगरी] Many schemes are meant for families below specific income limits or BPL thresholds.
disability_why: [डोगरी] Special pensions, assistive devices, and quotas exist for persons with disabilities.
handoff_title: [डोगरी] Your recordings have reached a helper
handoff_desc: [डोगरी] A trained civic helper is reviewing your voice responses to complete your profile.
busy_day_desc: [डोगरी] Our helpers are currently busy. We have scheduled a confirmed callback slot for you tomorrow.
reminder_scheduled: [डोगरी] We will send an SMS and notification 15 minutes before your slot.
profile_ready_notification: [डोगरी] Your profile is ready! Tap to view your ranked schemes.
docs_locked_notice: [डोगरी] Documents unlock after speaking to the Help Desk or choosing to skip.
skip_help_desk: [डोगरी] I already understand, skip to documents
physical_office_address: [डोगरी] Or visit nearby CSC / Gram Panchayat office
no_proxy_notice: [डोगरी] Umeed does not submit applications on your behalf. We guide you to the official window.
delete_data_confirm: [डोगरी] Are you sure? This will erase your profile and cached voice recordings immediately.
disclaimer: [डोगरी] Disclaimer: Umeed is an informational and guidance tool. Final eligibility and approvals are decided solely by the respective government authority.
q_sector_focus: [doi] Which area or sector do you need help in? (Finance, Agriculture, Health, Housing, Education, Jobs, Pension)
choose_gist_language: [doi] In which language would you like your scheme summary and gist?
query_help_desk: [doi] Have a question about this scheme? Ask the Help Desk
type_query_hint: [doi] Type or speak your question for the helper...
